hypothesis: A joint linear model over original raw TS-Z20 and its square may express a U/inverted-U response; changing alpha for only one feature cannot add this shape.
basis_construction: The square is formed from the raw per-symbol TS-Z20 before either basis has independent same-date MAD/zscore postprocessing. It is not the square of v3 normalized_value.

turnover_z20_v3.formula_expr: iif(count(turnover_rate - turnover_rate, 20) == 20, iif(stddev(turnover_rate, 20) > 1e-8, (turnover_rate - mean(turnover_rate, 20)) / stddev(turnover_rate, 20), 0), None)
turnover_z20_v3.source: Existing frozen v3; preserve factor version and active pointer

turnover_z20_squared.formula_expr: iif(count(turnover_rate - turnover_rate, 20) == 20 and stddev(turnover_rate, 20) > 1e-8, ((turnover_rate - mean(turnover_rate, 20)) / stddev(turnover_rate, 20)) ** 2, iif(count(turnover_rate - turnover_rate, 20) == 20, 0, None))

domain_contract.complete_window: Exactly 20 finite turnover observations including current; count(T-T,20) rejects missing and +/-Infinity observations
domain_contract.dispersion: Same v3 population stddev: std > 1e-8 uses Z; otherwise a complete finite window returns 0, preserving the existing near-zero threshold
domain_contract.missing: An incomplete/nonfinite window returns None; exclude must preserve this through degenerate cross-sectional normalization
domain_contract.negative_and_zero: Same v3 finite-value domain: zeros and negative finite values are not newly rejected; the current source has no negative turnover
domain_contract.observation_clock: 20 actual ordered bars per symbol, not 20 exchange sessions; no synthesized observations
domain_contract.unit_scaling: Positive constant unit scaling cancels when both scaled stddev values remain above the unchanged 1e-8 numerical guard; mixed historical units are not repaired
domain_contract.future_data: No future reference; adding future bars cannot change earlier raw or normalized values
domain_contract.cross_section: Per-date full universe MAD(3) then zscore(ddof=0); valid constant/singleton inputs map to 0 while missing positions remain missing unless explicit impute_zero

research_limits: Exactly one new basis function and one predeclared joint model hypothesis, no results-driven feature budget expansion.
Original single-feature v3 remains the benchmark on the same finite joined samples.
Use rank target, equal-date weights, the original four alphas and purged training-only selection; production gates stay unchanged.
The already observed outer 50 dates are a development comparison, not a new blind holdout.
The earlier abs-log/persistence/intraday feasibility proposals are not evaluated against returns in this phase.
